title: Haunted Painting
description: A museum security guard in a blue uniform and yellow gloves stands at a desk with cleaning supplies, a walkie-talkie, and keys. Behind him, a large framed painting depicts a blood-stained green hallway with red lighting, an exit sign, and dripping blood running down the frame onto the museum floor.
prompt: A surreal horror scene inside an art museum where a security guard in blue uniform and yellow rubber gloves cleans a desk with spray bottle, coffee cup and walkie-talkie. A giant ornate painting on the wall shows a terrifying blood-soaked green hallway with red emergency lighting, peeling walls, and an exit sign. Real blood drips from the bottom of the painting frame onto the museum floor as rain falls through a broken skylight.
